function (appPath = getwd(), appFile = NULL, appName = NULL,

        rPath <- file.path(R.home("bin"), "R")

            cmd, "\""))

                if (tries > 500) {
                  stop("Failed to start log listener.")
                }
            }, warning = function(...) {
            })
        }
        on.exit(close(logReader), add = TRUE)
        repeat {
            tryCatch({
                if (file.exists(killfile)) 
                  break
                writeLines(readLines(con = logReader, warn = FALSE))
                Sys.sleep(0.1)
            }, interrupt = function(...) {
                close(file(killfile, open = "wt"))
            }, error = function(e, ...) {
                print(e$message)
            })
        }
    }

You can run it locally and see how much memory the R process consumes.
If you reduce the amount of data loaded such that it doesn't run out of memory on shinyapps.io, we provide metrics at 1 minute granularity that can be viewed on the dashboard or obtained via the rsconnect package.
